name: [[834,32,20]] [[4,2,2]]-amplified [[170,16,10]] weight-6 two-block generalized bicycle on Z_85

provenance.construction: One [[4,2,2]] distance-amplification step (CSS tensor product, central three-term truncation, arXiv:2609.37231 Eq. 1/Eq. 12-15) applied to the board's [[170,16,10]] weight-6 two-block generalized bicycle on Z_85 entry, using a sparse independent-row presentation of its checks: n' = 4n + m_X + m_Z = 834, k' = 2k = 32, w' = w+1 = 7. X/Z witnesses are the base witnesses tensored with the weight-2 [[4,2,2]] logical on the central register (weights 20/20); the doubled distance is certified by the logical-overlap criterion (d' >= 2d) and no lighter logical was found in a 100,000-trial accelerator search on the first-tier candidates of the same family. Base provenance: Generalized bicycle (two-block) code on Z_85: H_X=[A|B], H_Z=[B^T|A^T], a(x)=x^8+x^33+x^46, b(x)=x^3+x^18+x^70; g=gcd(a,b,x^85-1) irreducible of degree 8, k=2*deg(g)=16, row weight 6. Full circulant check sets kept (redundant rows carry the symmetry).
provenance.notes: Constructed and packaged with the Space Bunny Alpha 1.0 model.
